about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: Computer Engineering graduate from Andrés Bello Catholic University (UCAB) and a Spanish citizen, with 3 years building production systems end to end — from the database schema to the deployed UI.
about.paragraph2: I work across TypeScript and Go. I have shipped and operated multi-tenant SaaS, marketplaces, banking integrations and LLM services, with automated testing as a default rather than an afterthought: La Torre carries 2,900 automated tests and Artitek Payments 740.
about.paragraph3: Since 2026 I have run Artitek, my own software consultancy, where I am the sole engineer designing, building and operating three production systems — including the direct technical relationship with the bank behind the payment integration. I took the first of them from architecture to a paying client in six months.

laTorre.title: La Torre — multi-tenant SaaS for condominium administration
laTorre.description: Assessment engine with pro-rating by aliquot, dual currency at the official rate, FIFO allocation of payments to charges and bank reconciliation, plus background workers for overdue detection, reminders and voting. Layered architecture across a monorepo of applications and shared packages, using a typed ok/error result instead of exceptions. 2,900 automated tests. Includes receipt reading from a photo: the resident uploads an image and the form fills itself in.

artitekPayments.title: Artitek Payments — multi-tenant payment gateway
artitekPayments.description: 30 domains in a hexagonal architecture integrated with Venezuelan banking: C2P, SIMF instant debit, POS, transfers, reversals and hosted checkout. Per-tenant isolation, idempotency by external reference, signed webhooks with retries, a circuit breaker over the bank, consumer identity via mTLS and card data redacted at the type level (OWASP ASVS L2). Reconciliation of the local ledger against the bank. 740 automated tests.

artitekExtraction.title: Artitek Extraction — LLM document extraction service
artitekExtraction.description: Async API with signed webhooks returning typed data and per-field confidence, never a verdict: the confidence threshold routes to human review before an amount reaches the ledger. Includes an evaluation harness against a hand-labelled golden set that compares models on accuracy and cost per document.

kompii.title: Kompii — vehicle consignment marketplace
kompii.description: The owner leaves the car with the platform, which lists and sells it on their behalf and settles the proceeds minus commission. I modelled the vehicle lifecycle across consignment agreement, listing, reservation, sale and seller payout — each stage with its own state, permissions and money implications. I led a full product redesign without interrupting service.

carshop.title: CarShop — automotive marketplace
carshop.description: A marketplace of auto repair shops where users request quotes, book services and keep a history, while businesses see quality and satisfaction metrics. I migrated the platform from Ruby on Rails to Next.js, rebuilding the frontend and the API layer without losing existing functionality.

eddu.title: Eddu — educational platform
eddu.description: An educational platform built and operated end to end, from database design through the full frontend, across successive feature releases. Reporting modules, process automation, collections and notifications.

ministeriosId.title: Ministerios Id — institutional website
ministeriosId.description: Institutional site with a video hero section, pages on doctrine, mission and outreach, volunteering and donation forms, and a contact system with email notifications via Resend.
